description: Parity ledger contract for the bundled-vs-hub answer-leg engine request (specs/artifacts/planning/engine-parity-instrument.md AC-3). Every JSON-path difference between the two captured requests must be listed here with a reason, or the diff fails. Shrinking this list is the refactoring driver.

documented_retrieval_divergence.reason: POST-D18 residuals only (both arms select AND interpret via querystore getContextSlice with interpret=true — ADR Decisions 17+18; verified 2026-07-22: identical 51-record slices at source for the same question). The mandatory clinical core is a HARD equality gate in the diff, never excusable here. Two named, deliberate hub-side residuals remain: (1) token-budget ceiling — the hub trims tail-priority slice records to its input limit (ceiling-not-target; mandatory never dropped), while bundled renders the full slice and relies on the engine's explicit chart_too_large overflow; (2) lexical union — the hub's exact/overlap tiers may add records beyond the slice (roadmap: ranked candidates are additive, never a replacement). Measured post-D18: 49v48, 52v85, 57v77.
